===Field list===
*copyright (Displays a copyright warning)
*width (Width modifier)
*background (defaults to white &ndash; #ffffff)

===Details===
This template can be used to format items in a similar manner to [[Template:Excerpt]] except that it is for situations where a the information being presented is split over multiple sources. Each source in the template is represented with a separate [[Template:ExcerptSection]]

===Usage===
'''Example'''
<pre>{{Multiexcerpt|
{{ExcerptSection|This information is from source one.</div>
|source=Source 1
|attrib=Author 1
}}
{{ExcerptSection|This information is from source two.</div>
|source=Source 2
|attrib=Author 2
}}
|copyright=true}}</pre>

'''Result'''
{{Multiexcerpt|
{{ExcerptSection|This information is from source one.
|source=Source 1
|attrib=Author 1
}}
{{ExcerptSection|This information is from source two.
|source=Source 2
|attrib=Author 2
}}
|copyright=true}}
